page.layout: One page of text, one column; no margin notes beside the column; below the column a catchword-like word "inge-" at right; a dark scan edge at the top is not printed text.

main_text.p: bilum, quod iactis per aerem facibus ingeminatur? famam, quae vbique repetito muralis machinae strepitu euulgatur? frequentiam, quae accurrentibus vndique accolis, per vicos, per castra, per vrbes confusa letitia stipatur? Adeo sane, vt ore suo Imperatrix Margarita confessa sit, se non potuisse Venetae Reip. Maiestatem habere melius confpectam, quam in Valerio, quem gazae omnes, fortuna, honor, triumphi, gentiumq; studia comitantur. Haec omnia hisce oculis videbam ego, & mirabar, cum inter caeteros me quoq; Legationis tuae asseclam, pro eximia, qua fleKteris, humanitate, blandiq;

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some words at line ends are hyphenated in the print and are joined here where the hyphen is printed. The word "fleKteris" is doubtful: the scan shows "fle-" and "cteris" (likely "flecteris"), so the reading is marked as uncertain. Dark scan edge at top and faint show-through at bottom are not transcribed. Catchword "inge-" is at the foot right and is also repeated as a foot note in the text, and "Valerio," in italics is uncertain at the comma position.
